name: Sara Gelser Blouin

bio.statement: In her pamphlet statement, Gelser Blouin lists her occupation as State Senator, with prior service as a State Representative and on the Corvallis School Board and the National Council on Disability.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Senator Prior Governmental Experience: State Representative, Corvallis School Board, National Council on Disability

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Benton/Linn/Lane edition (Book 6), p. 38

positions.statement: The statement says Gelser Blouin fought against the expansion of Coffin Butte Landfill and passed legislation requiring comprehensive methane monitoring.
positions.excerpt: Sara fought against the expansion of Coffin Butte Landfill and passed legislation requiring comprehensive methane monitoring.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Benton/Linn/Lane edition (Book 6), p. 38

positions.statement: The statement says Gelser Blouin voted to expand the working families tax credit, remove medical debt from credit reports and stop data centers from driving up electricity prices.
positions.excerpt: Sara voted to expand the working families tax credit, remove medical debt from credit reports, stop data centers from driving up electricity prices and help Oregonians save for a home down payment.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Benton/Linn/Lane edition (Book 6), p. 38

positions.statement: The statement says Gelser Blouin supports abortion rights and championed legislation protecting access to reproductive and gender-affirming care.
positions.excerpt: Sara is staunchly pro-choice and championed legislation protecting access to reproductive and gender-affirming care.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Benton/Linn/Lane edition (Book 6), p. 38

positions.statement: The statement says Gelser Blouin led reforms improving safety and transparency in memory care and assisted living facilities.
positions.excerpt: She led landmark reforms improving safety and transparency in memory care and assisted living facilities.

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Benton/Linn/Lane edition (Book 6), p. 38

positions.statement: The statement says Gelser Blouin voted to increase penalties for fentanyl dealers and championed eliminating Oregon's backlog of untested rape kits.
positions.excerpt: She voted to increase penalties for fentanyl dealers and successfully champi-oned elimination of Oregon’s backlog of untested rape kits.
